description: Real-time multi-UPS monitoring system with local USB drivers, remote WireGuard agents, interactive WebUI dashboards, Home Assistant MQTT Discovery, and smart Viber alerting.
changelog: Fixed MQTT connection authorization handling and added dynamic paho-mqtt loader
Added live test connection feedback without modal dismissal and deep merge for settings
Added native Home Assistant MQTT Discovery with dynamic multi-UPS telemetry support for all local and network UPS units
Added full MQTT configuration, real-time connectivity status badges, and discovery testing in the WebUI Settings modal
Added live Power (Watts) and Current (Amperes) telemetry metrics to each UPS card in the WebUI with balanced 4-column electrical layout
Sanitized public documentation and remote agent references, replacing private server IPs with <YOUR_SERVER_IP>
Unified project branding to Title Case (Electra) across dashboard header, runners, and installation scripts
Complete GitLab purge and GitHub-first authenticated update syncing for private repository installations
Fixed Megatec/Cypress low-load ADC oscillation (0% vs 7-8%) with Q1 priority and smart anti-flicker debouncing
Added standalone manual updater (update.py/update.bat/update.sh) for remote agents with config preservation and conflict alerts
Added central server package distribution endpoint for remote agents (/api/remote/agent/update-package)
Dynamic multi-remote UPS auto-discovery and automatic slot allocation (Remote-1, Remote-2, ...)
Multi-remote UPS profile management in WebUI Settings with custom display names, locations, and rated power
